description:
1. Fetch the page at http://localhost:8765/eco-camping-gear using WebFetch or curl.
2. Analyze all on-page SEO elements per the SKILL.md multi-step workflow:
   - Title Tag: detect the 78-char title (too long, >60 limit) and that 'eco camping gear' does not appear at the front.
   - Meta Description: detect the 82-char description (too short, needs 150-160 chars).
   - Header Structure: detect MISSING H1 (critical), multiple H2s acting as H1, and skipped levels (H2→H4 with no H3).
   - Images: detect 3 images with no alt text attributes.
   - Internal Links: detect 3 instances of 'click here' as non-descriptive anchor text.
3. Produce a scored audit report using ✅/⚠️/❌ criterion tables and numeric X/10 scores per section, with a prioritized fix plan (critical/important/minor).
4. Save the audit to memory/audits/on-page-seo-auditor/YYYY-MM-DD-eco-camping-gear.md containing: one-line verdict, top 3-5 actionable items, open loops, source data references — exactly as specified in the SKILL.md 'Save Results' section.

The proprietary trap: The agent must know (a) the exact save path `memory/audits/on-page-seo-auditor/`, (b) the YYYY-MM-DD-<topic>.md filename convention, (c) the required internal sections of the saved file, and (d) the specific character-count thresholds (50-60 title, 150-160 meta) and ✅/⚠️/❌ table format — none of which are in the prompt.
